scene.ko: 비행 중 멀미가 나서 승무원에게 도움을 청하고, 덜 흔들리는 자리로 옮겨 달라고 부탁한다.

lines.en: Excuse me. I'm sorry to bother you, but I'm not feeling very well.
lines.ko: 저기요. 귀찮게 해서 죄송한데요, 몸이 좀 안 좋아요.
alt: Excuse me, sorry to bother you, but I feel sick.
Excuse me. Sorry, I'm not feeling well.

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. What seems to be the problem?
I feel dizzy and a little sick to my stomach. I think it's the turbulence.
lines.ko: 어지럽고 속이 좀 메스꺼워요. 기체가 흔들려서 그런 것 같아요.
alt: I'm dizzy and I feel a bit sick. I think it's because of the turbulence.

lines.en: Would you like some water and a sick bag? We also have medicine for motion sickness.
lines.ko: 물과 위생 봉투를 드릴까요? 멀미약도 있습니다.

lines.en: Some water would be great, thanks. I'd rather not take medicine unless I have to.
lines.ko: 물 주시면 좋겠어요, 고마워요. 꼭 필요하지 않으면 약은 안 먹고 싶어요.
alt: Water would be great, thank you. I don't want to take medicine if I don't have to.

lines.en: That's understandable. Sitting near the middle of the plane might help. It moves less there.
lines.ko: 이해합니다. 비행기 가운데 쪽에 앉으시면 도움이 될 수 있어요. 거기가 덜 흔들리거든요.

lines.en: Is there an empty seat I could move to? I'm stuck by the window at the back.
lines.ko: 옮겨 앉을 수 있는 빈자리가 있나요? 뒤쪽 창가 자리에 끼어 있어서요.
alt: Is there an empty seat I can move to? I'm in a window seat at the back.

lines.en: Let me check... There's an aisle seat in row 21. I can move you once the seatbelt sign is off.
lines.ko: 확인해 볼게요... 21열에 통로 자리가 있어요. 안전벨트 표시등이 꺼지면 옮겨 드릴게요.

lines.en: That would be perfect. I really appreciate you going out of your way.
lines.ko: 그러면 정말 좋겠어요. 일부러 신경 써 주셔서 정말 감사해요.
alt: That would be perfect. Thank you for going to so much trouble.

lines.en: No problem at all. Just press the call button if you feel worse.
lines.ko: 별말씀을요. 더 안 좋아지시면 호출 버튼을 눌러 주세요.

expressions.en: I'm sorry to bother you, but ___.

expressions.note: sick to my stomach = 속이 메스꺼운

expressions.en: I really appreciate you going out of your way.
expressions.ko: 일부러 신경 써 주셔서 정말 감사해요.
expressions.note: go out of your way = 일부러 애쓰다
